It is tough new world. Voat is fresh on the scene and does not have that large of a user base; this means that we have very little content. I find myself each day scrolling through the same content over and over. I have tried going to new and different subverses only to find that content is provided by only one or two users. Our base may be growing, but it appears to be only lurkers/commentators. I can be guilty of this as well.

The one thing about that other place was that there was an enormous amount of people who would provide new content throughout the day, everyday. This brought in more people, which then brought in more producers of original content.

My question is this: Is it acceptable to repost things from Reddit to Voat? Why or why not? On one hand it will provide the content and entertainment that new users crave; on the other it seems kind of dirty and... 9gag-ish. What do you think?
Reposting content from You-Know-Where: Should this be acceptable?

Why not? People posting to Reddit are getting a lot of that from somewhere else anyway. Plus, somethings are going to be interesting enough to end up posted at both places anyway like any major news story. I wouldn't be surprised if something that gets posted here first ends up over there eventually. It should really depend on what is getting posted and if it is being posted to the right subverse for it.
I think reposting should remain incidental to the organic way of content producing
Why have we left "You know where" to have so many rules about "Should we do this?", "Should we ban that?". The question answers itself. Remember where you are.
It ties into our own sense of morality. We want to take nearly all elements of what was once good about reddit, but we don't want to become so much of a clone that we become what we hated.

One thing I can't stand is seeing the same front page with the same dumb titles. If you're going to repost, repost great links from less popular subs, not the top of adviceanimals or gifs. We don't need more shit posts here. But we do need more quality in the less trafficked subs. Make it your responsibility to produce content in smaller communities, and the reposting will be more acceptable.

We don't have the user base to match reddit where we can just rely on ourselves to continuously generate content. Lurkers will look at voat for 5 minutes, see everything there is to see, then go back to reddit where there's more content. Might as well cross post here and keep the attention within voat.

Now that's not to say post every little meaningless post from reddit, only the good stuff. We should still be selective and put quality before quantity. Eventually we'll get big enough that both sites will be posting the same things coincidentally.

Nah. I don't think it's a freat idea. Not wholesale anyway. We might have to rename ourselves BuzzVoat. Hehehe. But seriously I think we should all do what we think is right individually. We don't have to agree!

Basically, who cares? It doesn't really matter. I prefer if voaters would link to an article/content instead of an 'other place' thread and will spend my upgoats accordingly. Though, even if my upgoats don't go towards it, the practice should not be banned. I mean, let's not censor, except for the other place? nah, not a good move.
Yes. This is a content aggregation site. It shouldn't matter if the content was linked to other sites already. Hell, it would only make it harder for Voat to prosper.

There are no bugs on any of the leaves or any signed of the leaves or apples being eaten. The back of the leaves are clean, no eggs or black spots.

I live in central Alberta, Canada.
